local p = {}
local glossary = require('Module:glossary')._main
local data = mw.loadData("Module:Weapon skill/data")

local function useGlossary(text)
    return text:gsub("{{G|(.-)}}", function(params)
    	params = mw.text.split(params, '|')
        return tostring(glossary(params))
    end)
end

local function fillText(pattern, values, rank)
    if #values > 0 and type(values[1]) ~= "table" then
        values = {values}
    end
    return (pattern:gsub("{(%d+)}", function(idx)
        local groupIndex = tonumber(idx) + 1
        local group = values[groupIndex]
        if not group then
            return "{missing}"
        end
        if type(group) == "table" then
            return tostring(group[rank] or "{missing}")
        elseif type(group) == "number" then
            return tostring(group)
        else
            return "{missing}"
        end
    end))
end

local function buildHead(icon, colnames)
    local out = {}

    table.insert(out,
        '<div class="mw-collapsible mw-expanded collapsible-table-wrapper" data-expandtext="Show effects" data-collapsetext="Hide effects" style="width:50%;">'
    )

    table.insert(out,
        '{| id="skill-info-block" class="mrfz-wtable mrfz-tabber" width="100%" border="1" cellpadding="5" style="margin-bottom:0; font-size:12px; border: 3px solid; border-color: #3c3c3c;"'
    )

    table.insert(out,
        '!width="70px" style="border-right:none; text-align:center;"|' ..
        '[[File:Weapon-' .. (icon or "DefaultIcon") .. '.png|65x65px|link=]]'
    )

    table.insert(out,
    	'!style="border-left:none;text-align:left;"|' ..
    	'<div style="font-size:14px;">Weapon Skills</div>' ..
    	'<div style="padding-top:5px;">' ..
    	'<div title="Ability" style="display:inline-block; cursor:help; position:relative; margin:2px 0; padding:0 5px; width:auto; border-radius:5px; background:#BF00FF; color:white; font-size:12px; text-align:center; font-weight: normal;">Ability</div>' ..
    	'</div>'
	)

    table.insert(out, '|}')
    table.insert(out, '<div class="mw-collapsible-content">')

    table.insert(out,
        '{| width="100%" class="mrfz-wtable" border="1" cellpadding="5" style="margin-top:0; font-size:12px; border: 3px solid; border-color: #3c3c3c;"'
    )

    table.insert(out, '|-')
    table.insert(out, '!width="40px"|Rank')

    for _, colname in ipairs(colnames) do
        if colname and colname ~= "" then
            table.insert(out, '!width="auto"|' .. colname)
        else
            table.insert(out, '!width="auto"|–')
        end
    end

    return table.concat(out, "\n")
end

local function buildRows(colnames)
    local out = {}
    for rank = 1, 9 do
        table.insert(out, '|-')
        table.insert(out,
            '!style="text-align:center;"|' ..
            '[[File:Rank ' .. rank .. '.png|35x35px|center|link=]]'
        )
        for _, key in ipairs(colnames) do
            local entry = data[key]
            if entry and entry.values then
                local txt = fillText(entry.text, entry.values, rank)
				txt = useGlossary(txt)
				table.insert(out, '|style="text-align:center;"|' .. txt)
            else
                table.insert(out, '|style="text-align:center;"|&ndash;')
            end
        end
    end
    return table.concat(out, "\n")
end

local function buildEnd()
    return '|}</div></div>'
end

function p.main(frame)
    local args = frame:getParent().args
    local icon = args[1] or "DefaultIcon"
    local skill1 = args[2]
    local skill2 = args[3]
    local skill3 = args[4]
    local columns = { skill1, skill2, skill3 }
    local out = {}
    table.insert(out, buildHead(icon, columns))
    table.insert(out, buildRows(columns))
    table.insert(out, buildEnd())
    return table.concat(out, "\n")
end

return p
